title: The contrarian direction: disagree with the user on principle, argue anything
written: 2026-10-15, before the run. Status: NOT RUN.
why: Anti-sycophancy as a direction: does 'contrarianism' exist as a steerable axis - a model that takes the opposite side whenever a counterargument is constructible, even a ludicrous one divorced from facts? If sycophancy is concentrated because RLHF optimized it (exp106's gate: cos ~0.01 to everything), its mirror should be too - both poles live on one 'user-stance' axis. The scientifically interesting quantity is not disagreement rate alone but the DOSE-DEPENDENT COLLAPSE OF ARGUMENT QUALITY: low-dose contrarian steering should produce genuine steelmanning; high-dose should produce fabricated counterarguments to settled facts (2+2=5 territory). That transition - from useful devil's advocate to epistemic vandalism - is the finding.

design.direction: L18, paired extraction: CONTRARIAN12 (first-person: I argue the opposite of whatever is said, I can construct a case for any position, disagreement on principle) minus AGREEABLE12 (I find merit in the user's view). build_vectors recipe, abliterated 4B, MPS.
design.probe: 8 TRIVIALLY-TRUE statements (settled facts, e.g. 'the sun is a star', 'water boils at 100C at sea level') + 4 reasonable-opinion statements + 4 wrong statements (control: contrarian vs CORRECTION - a good contrarian still corrects wrong users). Scored by keywords locally, judged later.
design.conditions: noop / contra at 1/2/3/4x / neg / rand at 2x.
design.measures: disagreement rate on true facts (fabricated-counter rate), disagreement on opinions, correction rate on wrong statements (should stay HIGH until the axis swallows accuracy too).

hypotheses.H1: contra raises disagreement on all statement classes vs noop and rand, monotonically with dose.
hypotheses.H2: correction of WRONG statements degrades only at high dose (the argument-quality collapse point) - the dose response separates 'devil's advocate' from 'contrarian vandalism'.
hypotheses.H3: gate: contrarian cos vs sycophancy direction is strongly negative (> -0.9, i.e. same axis opposite pole) OR orthogonal - either result places it on the map.

safety: Register-only passages; no harmful content; probing disagreement about trivial facts cannot produce harm. Outputs gitignored, vectors never deployed.
